sentences: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra at half the price of its predecessor while Anthropic raised a $13 billion Series F led by Iconiq.
The funding tape stayed busy as Anthropic closed its round and Guidewire agreed to acquire hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash.
On the benchmark boards, GPT-6.1 Terra scored 95.1 on SWE-bench, setting the week's reference point.
Chip stocks rallied again, with NVIDIA up 4.1 percent on the week.
Underneath the launches, buyers kept debating whether agent telemetry is ready for real deployments.

items.headline: GPT-6.1 Terra
items.one_liner: OpenAI's mid-tier computer-use model lands at half the price of GPT-5.6 Terra.

sources.excerpt: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra. The price now sits at half of its predecessor, GPT-5.6 Terra.

items.headline: GPT-6.1 Terra sets the SWE-bench mark
items.one_liner: OpenAI's new model tops the verified coding board.

sources.excerpt: GPT-6.1 Terra scored 95.1 on SWE-bench Verified, the highest verified score this week.

items.headline: 1Password for Agents
items.one_liner: Credential vault access scoped for autonomous agents, in public preview.

sources.excerpt: 1Password opened a public preview of agent-scoped credential access.

items.headline: Anthropic raised $13B Series F led by Iconiq
items.one_liner: The round values the lab at $183 billion post-money.

sources.excerpt: Anthropic has closed a $13 billion Series F round led by Iconiq, valuing the company at $183 billion.

items.headline: Guidewire → hyperexponential
items.one_liner: The insurance software giant buys the underwriting AI startup outright.

sources.excerpt: Guidewire will acquire hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash, the companies announced.
NVIDIA closed the week at 182.40, up 4.1 percent, extending the chip rally.

items.headline: Is agent telemetry ready for production?
items.one_liner: Vendors say tracing is solved; platform teams keep filing gap reports.

sources.excerpt: Vendors argued agent telemetry has matured enough for production deployments.
Platform teams countered with gap reports on missing spans and silent tool failures.
